tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /spyod rgyud sogs nas bshad pa'i dpal mgon don lnga la mchod cing 'phrin las bcol tshul 'jug bde bzhugs/
༄༅/ /spyod rgyud sogs nas bshad pa'i dpal mgon don lnga la mchod cing 'phrin las bcol tshul 'jug bde bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /spyod rgyud sogs nas bshad pa'i dpal mgon don lnga la mchod cing 'phrin las bcol tshul 'jug bde bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal mgon don lnga la mchod cing 'phrin las bcol tshul 'jug pa bde ba zhig bshad par bya ste/ bde dgyes sbyod rgyud sogs dang*/ de dag gi dgongs 'grel gyi rgya bod kyi gzhung du ma las rang gzhan gyi 'gal rkyen sel zhig mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i ched du/ dpal mgon don lnga po thams cad dang*/ de dag las sde tshan ci rigs blangs nas mchod cing 'phrin las bcol tshul bshad pa mang zhing*/ da lta gsang bde 'jigs gsum dag kun rig sogs kyi cho ga'i sngon 'gror phyogs skyong la mchod gtor bya tshul dang*/ gdugs dkar bzlog chen dang snang brgyad dang*/ cha gsum gyi cho gar yang 'di dag la mchod gtor dang 'phrin las bcol tshul bshad pa ltar te/ phyag len byed tshul la mi 'dra bar 'ga' re snang yang 'dir phyogs gcig tu byas nas mchod tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i pa'i dbus nas lte ba'i mthar zlum skor rim pa bdun byas pa'i dang po la pad 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la bcu'am brgyad/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa rnams brgyad re/ drug pa la nyer brgyad dam bzhi/ bdun pa dgu'am brgyad bya zhing*/ pad+ma ma grub na thams cad la thig le re byas te mdun du stegs kyi khar bzhag nas tshom bu dgod/ shin tu bsdus na gtso bo'i gnas su thig le dang tshom bu dgod cing*/ gnas gzhan rnams su gro nas sogs kyi me tog bkram/ dbus su phyag rdor gyi tsa ga li yod na legs shing*/ mthar dar shog sogs kyi yol ba dang*/ 'phan dar sogs kyi rnam pa bya/ mdun nam mthar nyer spyod sogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ zlum gtor lto ba cung zad ldir ba rgyan dang ldan pa'i mthar gtor phran bdun brgyad sogs mtheb kyu ril bu dang bcas pa dang*/ 'bru sna/ dri sman/ zas sna/ shing tog dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ 'bras chan/ dar tshon/ rin po che sogs ci 'byor bshams la/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngon du btang nas bdag bskyed ni/ oṃ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga ba lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje g.yas gser gyi (rdo rje)rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sprul dang rin po ches brgyan cing dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi baur oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal gsang ba'i bdag po ye shes pa spyan drangs/ e h+ya hi/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon pa dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas shrīḥye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dgachu lha gam yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las/ mchod yaun/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ/

gis bar gyis byin brlabs byas la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod de/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod de mchog bstod bya'o/ / ༈ de nas mdun bskyed na/ sgrub gzhi la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las pho brang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la dpal phyag na rdo rje g.yas gser gyi rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i shar du yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang*/ lhor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri/ nub tu mi mig bzang dmar po sprul zhags/ byang du rnam thos sras ser po be con dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol kyi shar du brgya byin dkar po glang po che la zhon pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub/ lhor gshin rje nag po ma he la zhon pa g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa g.yas sprul zhags dang g.yon pad+ma/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po mi la=/ g.yas bi dzi pū ra ka dang g.yon ne'u le/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la=/ bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blug lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa/ ral gri dang thod pa/ nub byang du rlung lha dud kha sha ba la=/ rlung ras dang zhags pa/ byang shar du dbang phyug chen po dkar po khyu mchog la zhon pa/ rtse gsum dang go ri la 'khyud pa/ brgya byin gyi g.yas su tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa/ spyi blugs dang bgrang 'phreng*/

chu lha'i g.yas su sa'i lha mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa/ g.yas dam bca' ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar du dbang po dkar po g.yas rdo rje/ lhor tshangs pa ser po g.yas spyi blugs/ nub tu khyab 'jug nag po g.yas 'khor lo/ /byang du lha chen thal mdog g.yas rtse gsum/ shar lhor tshogs bdag dkar po la phug lho nub tu bh+ring gi ri ti nag po rin po che/ nub byang du dga' rab dbang phyug dmar po mda' gzhu/ byang shar du gdong drug dkar po dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar du stobs rgyu ljang khu/ lhor dung skyong ser po/ nub tu mtha' yas sngon po/ byang du nor rgyas dkar po/ shar lhor 'jog po dmar po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang khu/ nub byang du pad+ma chen po dkar po/ byang shar du pad+ma dkar po ste thams cad kyang stod mi dang smad sprul mjug can sprul zhags 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar du zla ba dkar po kun+da/ lhor nyi ma dmar po pad+ma/ nub tu mig dmar dmar po mdung thung*/ byang du lhag pa ljang khu mda' gzhu/ shar lhor phung bu ser po bgrang 'phreng*/ lho nub tu pa sangs dkar po phreng ba/ nub byang du spen pa nag po dbyug pa/ byang shar du sgra gcan dmar nag nyi zla 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar du tha skar dkar po/ /bra nye ljang khu/ smin drug ljang ser/ snar ma dmar skya/ mgo nag po/ lag dkar po/ nab so dkar po dang/ lhor rgyal ljang khu/ skag dkar po/ mchu dmar po/ gre ljang ser/ dbo ljang khu/ me bzhi dkar po/ nag pa ljang khu/ nub tu sa ri dkar po/ sa ga nag po/ lha mtshams ljang khu/ snron dkar po/ snubs dkar po/ chu stod nag po/ chu smad sngon po dang*/ byang du byi bzhin ljang khu/ gro bzhin dmar skya/ mon gru nag po/ mon gre ser po/ khrums stod ljang khu/ khrums smad ser po/ nam gru ser skya ste/ thams cad kyang bud med kyi rnam pa can/

lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar du 'jigs byed drag po mdogs nag po/ g.yas kha ṭ+waṃ ga lhor bhai ra wa sngo nag rtse gsum/ nub tu gnod sbyin dmar nag dbyug to/ byang du ye shes bhai ra ljang nag 'khor lo/ shar lhor khyab 'jug nag po mda' chen/ lho nub tu bi ti sngon nag shak+ti/ nub byang du kā la bhai ra dud kha ral gri/ byang shar du ga ṇa pa ti sngon nag rdo rje/ shar gyi drag po'i g.yas su ded dpon pra ma ti dkar po g.yas rin po che bsnams pa ste/ rgyu skar ma gtogs thams cad kyang rang rang gi chung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'o/ /sgo bzhi'i shar du rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog byang du rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu rdor dril 'dzin pa'o/ /de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ ri rab lhun po'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po la sogs pa'i rang rang so so'i gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal chen bzhi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad ded dpon dgu ste dpal mgon don lnga'i tshogs dang*/ sgo bzhi la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba rnams rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ spos bzung ste/ ting shag gam/ dril bu dkrol te/ dzaḥ rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs dpung*/ /gcig bsdus phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /bka' mnyan dpal mgon tshogs dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal chen bzhi po 'khor dang bcas/ / mchod sbyin=/ phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin=/

lha chen brgyad po=/ klu chen brgyad po=/ gza' chen brgyad po=/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad=/ 'jigs byed dgu po=/ sgo ma bzhi po=/ yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya'i bstan pa srung ba dang*/ bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis so so'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs la/ nyer spyod rnams sngar ltar dang*/ de'i mjug tu oṃ rū pa āḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs 'dod yon lnga byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod rdzas gzhan dang gtor ma rnams sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin brlab bya'am/ cung zad bsdu na/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ o swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe dharmāḥte badz+ra sid+dhi hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tat+khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis byin brlabs byas nas/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ zhes sogs brjod la/ 'jig rten khams kyi mchod tshogs dang*/ /bdag gis phul pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /dpal mgon don lnga'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan la sbyar nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/

gzugs mchogasgra mchog sogs dang*/ rū pa sogs sbyar nas 'bul zhing*/ gzhan yang 'bru sman rin chen dang*/ /dri dar gos dang zas mchog dang*/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs dang*/ /rin chen bdun dang ri rab gling*/ /nyi zla la sogs mchod tshogs kun/ /bcom ldan=/ dpal=/ bzhes=/ dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra ma hā pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ swāhā/ de nas lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog sogs dang*/ yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /rang rang 'khor 'dul phyogs bzhi srung*/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag/shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod=/ gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ ma mo'i rgyal po=/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i=/ mchod cing =/ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po= lho nub srin po'i=/ mchod cing =/ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /glu yi rgyal po=/ nub phyogs chu lha'i=/ mchod cing =/ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rin 'dzin rgyal po=/ nub byang rlung lha'i=/ mchod cing =/ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug pa thogs/ /nor skyong gdon=/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin=/ mchod cing =/ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po=/ byang shar dbang ldan=/ mchod cing =/ steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po dang*/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod=/ 'og gi klu ste sa yi lha=/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*/ /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu rgyal dang*/

/'jigs byed dgu dang sgo ma bzhi/ /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /khyed rnams mchod cing bstod byas pas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas badz+ra pā ṇi dang*/ sngags gzhan mi 'dra ba mang du snang yang*/ sbyod rgyud las gsungs pa'i bsdus pa ni/ rgyal chen bzhi la/ oṃ bā+ai/ oṃ dh+ri/ oṃ bi/ oṃ k+ṣa/ zhes dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu la/ oṃ ī/ oṃ i/ oṃ a/ oṃ ya/ oṃ ti/ oṃ ba/ oṃ ya/ oṃ ku/ oṃ ā/ oṃ ba/ zhes dang*/ lha chen brgyad la/ oṃ a/ oṃ bhi/ oṃ ru/ oṃ e/ oṃ kaṃ oṃ ga.oṃ ghī/ oṃ ka zhes dang*/ klu chen brgyad la/ oṃ phu/ oṃ pa/ oṃ phuṃ/ oṃ phaṃ/ oṃ phai/ oṃ phau/ zhes dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar la/ oṃ a/ oṃ so/ oṃ aṃ/ oṃ bu/ oṃ bri/ oṃ shu/ oṃ shi/ oṃ ra/ zhes dang*/ 'jigs byed dgu la/ oṃ bhai ra wa bhe swāhā/ oṃ bha swāhā/ oṃ bhi swāhā/ oṃ bhu swāhā/ oṃ bho swāhā/ oṃ bhai swāhā/ oṃ bhau swāhā/ oṃ bha swāhā/ oṃ bhaṃ swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dang a kā ro lan gsum gcig gam bdun dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā naṃ/ a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan gsum sogs kyis 'bul zhing*/ rgyas par na/ oṃ ru tra ye zhes sogs dang*/ shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /zhes sogs brjod cing zhu yang legs/ /gzhi bdag gtor ma yang spyi 'gro ltar bsngo/ de nas mchod rdzas bsngo ba dang lhan cig bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ/ rgyal kun mthu stobs nus pa'i tshogs/

/gcig bsdus rig sngags 'chang ba'i rje/ /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi/ /gtsor gyur rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud/ /ri rab lhun po'i phyogs bzhi na/ / gnas bcas rgyal po chen po bzhi/ /rang rang 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di zhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /brgya byin dkar po glang chen zhon/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse brgya 'dzin/ /brgya byin 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /dag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /gshin rje nag po ma he bcibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa 'dzin/ /gshin rje 'bum gyi= /mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /chu lha dkar po chu srin bcibs/ /phyag g.yas sprul gyi zhags pa 'dzin/ /chu lha 'bum gyi= /mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /gnod sbyin ser po mi la zhon/ /phyag g.yas sa bon grong khyer 'dzin/ / gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /me lha dmar po ra la zhon/ /phyag g.yas bgrang phreng spyi blug 'dzin/ /me lha 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /srin po nag po ro la zhon/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba 'dzin/ /srin po 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas/

/mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ / bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ / 'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /rlung lha dud kha sha ba bcibs/ /phyag g.yas rlung gi ba dan 'phyar/ /rlung lha 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /dbang phyug dkar po glang la zhon/ /phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin/ /'byung po 'bum 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /tshangs pa ser po ngang pa bcibs/ /phyag g.yas sbyi slug bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /tshangs pa 'bum 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /sa lha ser po pad+mar gnas/ /phyag g.yas dam bca'i phyag rgya can/ /sa bdag 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /kye/ srid pa gsum na mthu che ba'i/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod sbyin dam rdzas 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /rgya mtsho che la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod sbyin 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /nam mkha'i khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad kyis/

/mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /sde brgyad tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'jigs byed dgu po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /dpal mgon don lnga sgo ma bzhi/ /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis/ /mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /kye/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /bka' nyan dpal mgon tshogs kun kyang*/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan cing stobs dang ldan/ /srid gsum 'di na grags pa che/ /'jig rten khams kun srung zhing skyong/ /gzhan gyis mi thub mthu rtsal ldan/ /pha rol rgol ba'i dpung 'joms byed/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong*/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs tshar gcod mdzad/ /las dang mthun pa'i phan gnod dang*/ /cha lugs ma nges ci yang ston/ /gang gis mchod cing bskul ba de'i/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las sgrub/ /'jig rten pa yi tshul 'dzin yang*/ /dam pa'i sprul ba nyid du nges/ /de slad khyed rnams mchod byas pa/ /don ldan dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis/ /dpal mgon 'khor bcas mchod byas pas/ /khyed rnams mnyes shing tshim gyur cig /mnyes shing tshim nas bdag cag la/ /gnod pa'i mi mthun phyogs kun dang*/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog /gdon rigs sum brgya drug bcu bzlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog /god kha god 'dre thams cad zlog /tshe ring nad med longs spyod sogs/ /phun tshogs thams cad rgyas par mdzod/ /zhes bya'o/

/'di lo rim la byed na/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis la/ /yul 'di'i lo tog 'bru bcud la/ /gnod pa'i than ser zhi ba dang*/ /zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa la/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la/ /'tshe ba'i klu dang sa bdag gi /gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /zhes dang*/ rigs rgyud 'phel ba la/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /rigs brgyud 'phel zhing rgyas pa la/ /gnod pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /zhes bya/ god kha che na/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la/ / gnod pa'i god kha zhi ba dang*/ /zhes dang*/ longs spyod 'phel ba la/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /tshe dpal longs spyod phun tshogs sogs/ /'dod rgu'i 'byor ba ma lus pa/ yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /ces pa sgyur ba sogs rigs 'gre bya'o/ /mjug tu slar/ badz+ra pā ṇi lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha sogs kyis mchod la/ rgyal ba'i mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /bka' nyan dpal mgon don lnga'i tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas la gus pas bstod/ /de nas yig brgya bzlas te/ kyai/ gsang bdag dpal mgon khyed rnams la/ /mchod bstod 'phrin las bcol skabs 'dir/ /mchod pa ngan zhing bshams nyes dang*/ /ma 'byor ma gus ma rig pas/ /cho ga lhag chad gyur pa dang*/ khyed rnams mnyes par ma gyur pa'i/ /nyes pa thams can bdag 'chags so/ /brtse bas dgongs nas bzod bzhes te/ / mgon skyabs dpung gnyen g.yel med mdzod/ /da ni mgron du 'os pa rnams/ /steng 'og phyogs 'tshams gang dag nas/ /byon pa'i rang rang gnas rnams su/ /gshegs su gsol lo badz+ra muḥ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsams la sel gol gdab/ de nas pho brang mchod pa sogs bsdus nas mdo zlog dang*/ bkra shis rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya'o/ / dpal mgon 'di dag phal cher sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul du 'dug pas mthu nus bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/

rgyud dang dgongs 'grel dag las 'di dag gi sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs mi 'dra bar du ma bshad pa mthong ba las/ lugs gcig gi dbang du byas nas 'di rnams kyi zhabs tog dang gzhan re gnyis la phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis bsgrigs pa ste/ sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi 'god pa'i tshul gnyis snang ba las gang byas kyang mi 'gal mod 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas so/ /par gyi yi ge ba ni khru sha'i dge slong kun dga' nor bu'o/ /maṅga laṃ// //
